articles.title: Disk encryption on NetBSD: achieving secrecy
articles.summary: NetBSD developer Nia Alarie has written a guide on how to set up a NetBSD system with disk encryption that’s quite useful for those of us who deeply care about such a level of security.

articles.title: Get a big mixture of silly games in the Seriously Unserious Collection Humble Bundle
articles.summary: Now some of the issues have been solved from the recent Humble Store overhaul , it's time for a new highlight with the Seriously Unserious Collection Humble .

articles.title: 'iPhone 20 Pro' Rumored to Be Based on iPhone Air
articles.summary: Next year's "iPhone 20 Pro" models will use the same glass design as the iPhone Air , but with more pronounced curvature along all four sides, according to the leaker known as " Fixed Focus Digital ."

articles.title: New camera sensor coming to the iPhone 20 Pro’s main camera, says leaker
articles.summary: A brief report from leaker Ice Universe suggests that the iPhone 20 Pro will get a new and more sophisticated sensor for the main camera.

articles.title: Pixel Tag is a brilliant Band-Aid on a Find Hub network Google can’t easily fix
articles.summary: The Google Pixel Tag is here and, at least so far, it’s really good. But fresh hardware and some new features can’t fix the core problem.

articles.title: Wuthering Waves fixes for SteamOS / Linux in the new DWProton 11.0-17 release
articles.summary: DWProton that's popular for various Anime games on SteamOS / Linux has a new release out, to bring fixes for the latest Wuthering Waves updates.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
articles.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application.

articles.title: Google Pixel rolls out new ‘Family Hub’ feature with useful controls [Gallery]
articles.summary: First appearing earlier this month, Google Pixel phones are rolling out a handy new Family feature in the Settings menu. Here’s what it can do.

articles.title: Planetary Annihilation: TITANS finally gets a new modern UI system
articles.summary: Planetary Annihilation: TITANS has a new update out now, which finally tears out their old and unreliable UI system ready to keep expanding the game.

articles.title: Super Meat Boy Again+ announced reviving the classic tough platformer
articles.summary: Super Meat Boy is a tough as nails platformer originally released to much fanfare and great acclaim in 2010. It is held as a gold standard in difficult but fair platforming.

articles.title: When Should LLM Agents Forget? Memory Filtering Under Query-Critical Resolver Errors
articles.summary: LLM memory systems often delete facts classified as stale. We show that this hard-filtering step can reduce downstream accuracy when resolver errors delete query-critical facts.

articles.title: Does the Ranking Hold? A Practitioner-Facing Audit of Hallucination Detectors on Small, Quantized, On-Device LLMs
articles.summary: Hallucination detection for large language models is dominated by methods evaluated on 7B-70B research models with abundant sampling budgets and exact-match or ROUGE correctness labels.

articles.title: LoRAWeaver: Directional Adapter Routing in LoRA Representation Space
articles.summary: Large language models are expensive to update through full retraining. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning reduces the cost of adaptation, but repeated adaptation creates a growing pool of task-specific LoRA adapters.

articles.title: Tabular Population Priors as Structured Retrieval for EHR Medication Set Prediction
articles.summary: Medication prediction from electronic health records is a fixed vocabulary structured prediction problem, yet recent clinical RAG systems often treat it like open ended case based reasoning: retrieve similar patient admissions and ask an LLM to infer a medication set.

articles.title: GNU's Gawk 5.4.2 Released With Big Performance Improvement
articles.summary: Gawk as the GNU's implementation of the AWK programming language is out with a new release for this tool commonly used for extracting data and pattern matching / data manipulation.

articles.title: Purism Aiming To Deliver New Librem 5 Smartphone With RISC-V SoC
articles.summary: After the variety of delays and other challenges that Purism had with their Librem 5 smartphone, surprisingly, they are trying again now with the Librem 5 v2 smartphone being announced.

articles.title: Fwupd 2.1.10 Brings Fixes, New Synaptics Touchpad Supported
articles.summary: Lead Fwupd/LVFS developer Richard Hughes of Red Hat kicked off the new week by releasing Fwupd 2.1.10 as the newest stable release for performing firmware updates on Linux.

articles.title: Purism announces second-gen Librem 5 Linux phone
articles.summary: Purism is crowdfunding a new version of its Librem 5 Linux smartphone, this one powered by RISC-V rather than Arm. Librem 5 v2 will use an octa-core SpacemiT K1 RISC-V SoC, replacing the quad-core Arm64 NXP CPU.
